title: persicaria × intercedens
intro: Persicaria × intercedens, commonly known as 'Red Dragon', is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the Persicaria genus. This plant is valued for its vibrant foliage and stems, which display a reddish hue. The health benefits associated with Persicaria × intercedens include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are known for their therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system.
